description: This file contains unit tests for the Oblivious HTTP implementation in the quiche project, including test data structures, key generation functions, and a parameterized test case for end-to-end request and response handling.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpResponseTestStrings
classes.description: A struct holding test case data including request and response plaintexts, test case name, and key ID.

methods.name: GetHpkePrivateKey
methods.description: Returns a private HPKE key as a byte string by decoding a hex string.

methods.name: GetHpkePublicKey
methods.description: Returns a public HPKE key as a byte string by decoding a hex string.

methods.name: GetOhttpKeyConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns an ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig object with specified parameters.

methods.name: ConstructHpkeKey
methods.description: Constructs and initializes an EVP_HPKE_KEY object using provided key data and configuration.
